title: Slack message on signup
summary: Posts to a Slack channel whenever someone new signs up, with their name and email.
description: Fires when a row is added to your signup table and posts a short message to the Slack channel you choose, through your connected Slack integration. Until Slack is connected in the builder the step is skipped, so it is safe to add before you connect.

params.name: person
params.label: Who signs up
params.description: The table a new person lands in when they sign up (usually named after the role).

params.name: channel
params.label: Slack channel id
params.description: The id of the Slack channel to post in (in Slack: channel details, at the bottom, like C0123ABCD).

notes: Connect Slack in the builder's Integrations panel; until then the step is skipped.

includes: One workflow: on signup, post to your Slack channel
highlights: Skips quietly until Slack is connected
